title: Bread & Butter Pickles
ingredients: sufficient med. sized cukes to meas. 16 cups (washed, peeled & thinly sliced)
directions: Wash, peel & thinly slice sufficient med. sized cukes to meas. 16 cups.
Peel & thinly slice 6 med onions.
Combine in lg. preserving kettle. Sprinkle 1/3 c coarse salt between layers.
Mix a tray of ice cubes thru vegies & cover with another tray of cubes. Let stand 3 hrs. — Drain well.
Combine 3 c w. vinegar, 5 c sugar, 1 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 1/2 tsp celery seed, 2 tbsp mustard seed.
Heat comb. & add vegies. Heat just to boiling pt. No further cooking.
Pour into hot sterilized jars & seal.
Store 1 month before using for full flavour.

title: Bacon - Home cured - brine
directions: gradually add the brine mixture — the potato will float when the brine solution is about 80% — which is needed in curing.
Leave bacon in crock for 15-20 days — every few days take out the meat — stir the brine — put the meat back in — submerge the meat by weighting down with a jar of water.

After curing — each piece of meat should be rinsed briefly in fresh water to remove salt, then set aside to dry. — Pat meat with paper towel, lay on wire racks (not touching) — when dry a thin clear glossy coating of dissolved protein & nutrients will cover the surface — ready to smoke.
notes: Margin (sideways): Bacon was too salty after 15 days
